en.name: Fruit juice in cartons, fruit drinks and punch
en.summary: An unopened carton of fruit juice or fruit drink keeps 3 weeks from purchase, and 8–12 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once opened.
en.pantry: 3 weeks from purchase for a carton that is still sealed, kept cool, dark and dry. A chilled-cabinet carton and a shelf-stable one are not the same thing, so let the shop tell you: if it was sold refrigerated, keep it refrigerated. Once a carton is opened it is no longer a sealed sterile pack — air and whatever is on the spout get in — so open it and refrigerate it, and use the refrigerated window below rather than leaving it out.
en.fridge: 8–12 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once opened, capped and stored on a shelf rather than in the door. Juice is sugary and only mildly acidic, and fruit drinks and punches are often less acidic still, which makes them easier for yeasts and moulds to colonise once air is in the carton. Pour into a glass instead of drinking from the carton, because saliva introduces organisms that shorten the window considerably.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for cartoned juice, drinks or punch. Freezing works in practice if you decant into a container with headspace — a carton will split as the liquid expands — and thawed juice separates and needs shaking. Since no figure is published, treat it as a way to rescue a carton you cannot finish rather than as a storage plan, and thaw it in the fridge.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, never on the counter, then shake well. Treat thawed juice as opened juice and finish it within the refrigerated window.
spoilage: Fizzing or foaming on pouring, which means fermentation has begun.
A swollen or hard carton — gas from yeast activity.
Mould at the spout or under the cap, or floating on the surface.
A sharp, alcoholic or vinegary smell instead of a fruity one.
tips: Buy the size you will finish in a week or so; a large carton usually outlives its window.
Keep the opened carton on a fridge shelf, not in the door.
Pour into a glass rather than drinking from the carton.
Wipe the spout before recapping; mould usually starts there.

faq.q: How long does carton juice last once opened?
faq.a: 8–12 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, capped.

faq.q: Does unopened carton juice need refrigerating?
faq.a: If it was sold from a chilled cabinet, yes. A sealed shelf-stable carton keeps 3 weeks from purchase in a cool cupboard.

faq.q: How can you tell if fruit juice has gone bad?
faq.a: Smell it and look at the carton. Fizzing, a swollen pack, mould at the spout or an alcoholic smell all mean it goes.

zh.name: 盒裝果汁與果汁飲料
zh.summary: 未開封的盒裝果汁或果汁飲料自購買日起可放 3 週；開封後放 4 °C 以下冷藏 8～12 天。
zh.pantry: 未開封的紙盒，陰涼、避光、乾燥存放，自購買日起 3 週。冷藏櫃賣的和常溫架上賣的不是同一種東西，所以照店家怎麼放就怎麼放：冷藏櫃買的就繼續冷藏。一旦開封，它就不再是密封無菌的包裝了——空氣和開口上的一切都會進去——所以開了就冷藏，並使用下面那個冷藏窗口，而不是放在外面。
zh.fridge: 開封後蓋緊、放冰箱層架（不是門邊），4 °C 以下 8～12 天。果汁含糖、酸度只是中等，而果汁飲料和綜合果汁通常酸度更低，空氣一進去，酵母和霉菌更容易在裡面落腳。請倒進杯子喝，不要對著紙盒口喝，唾液帶進去的菌會大幅縮短這個窗口。
zh.freezer: 盒裝果汁與果汁飲料沒有公布的冷凍期限。實務上可行，但要倒進留有膨脹空間的容器——液體結凍會把紙盒撐破；解凍後會分層，需要搖勻。既然沒有公開數字，請把它當成「喝不完時的搶救手段」而不是保存計畫，並且用冷藏解凍。
zh.thawing: 請放冷藏解凍，不要放檯面上，之後搖勻。解凍後就當成已開封的果汁，在冷藏的期限內喝完。
spoilage: 倒出來起泡或冒沫，代表發酵開始了。
紙盒鼓脹、變硬——那是酵母產生的氣體。
開口處、蓋子內側或液面長霉。
聞起來尖酸、有酒味或醋味，而不是果香。
tips: 買一週左右喝得完的容量；大盒裝通常撐不到期限就先壞。
開封後放冰箱層架，不要放門邊。
倒進杯子喝，不要對著紙盒口喝。
蓋回去之前把開口擦乾淨；霉通常就是從那裡開始的。

faq.q: 盒裝果汁開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋緊放 4 °C 以下冷藏 8～12 天。

faq.q: 未開封的盒裝果汁要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 如果是冷藏櫃買的就要。常溫架上的未開封紙盒，自購買日起放陰涼櫥櫃 3 週。
聞一聞、看一看紙盒。起泡、包裝鼓脹、開口長霉或有酒味，都代表該倒掉。
